investment_thesis.summary: Roll-up of 4 regional less-than-truckload carriers. Value creation via route-density consolidation and disciplined fuel-surcharge pass-through pricing, underwritten to expand EBITDA margin from a ~12% entry level to ~18% by year 3 of the hold.
key_risks_at_underwriting: Fuel cost volatility compressing margin quarter-to-quarter
Integration risk across 4 legacy route networks

investment_thesis.summary: De novo clinic expansion (target 6 new sites over the hold) combined with payor-mix improvement (shifting toward commercial/in-network reimbursement) driving same-store revenue growth toward the underwritten case.
key_risks_at_underwriting: De novo clinic ramp slower than underwritten
Clinician staffing/retention in a tight labor market

loan_agreement.summary: Senior secured term loan supporting a dividend recapitalization. Financial covenant package centers on a Total Net Leverage ratio test, tested quarterly.

total_net_leverage.definition: Total Net Debt / Trailing Twelve Month Adjusted EBITDA
